agent_responses.response_str:
The travel cancellation policy has been appended to the Q3 2026 Business Report at `/workspace/docs/q3_report.md`. Here's a summary of what was added:

### Flight Cancellation
- **Free cancellation window:** Full refund within 24 hrs (domestic) or 48 hrs (international) of booking
- **Basic Economy:** Not cancellable after free window (unless insured)
- **Economy – Domestic:** Fee of max($50, 15% of ticket price)
- **Economy – International:** Fee of max($75, 20% of ticket price)
- **Business – Domestic/International:** 5% / 8% of ticket price
- **First Class:** Free cancellation
- **Travel Insurance:** Covers cancellation regardless of cabin class

### Hotel Cancellation
- **48+ hrs before check-in:** Free cancellation (standard rooms)
- **24–48 hrs:** 50% of first night charge
- **< 24 hrs:** Full first night charge
- **Suites:** Non-refundable

### Car Rental Cancellation
- **24+ hrs before pickup:** Free cancellation
- **< 24 hrs:** One day charge
- **Luxury/SUV:** Additional $50 surcharge at all times
